description: World IR meta → the mechanic runtime its activation assembles (core's createMechanicRuntime): which layers exist, what they share (one stamina pool spent by combat and traversal, the traversal planner as the locomotion graph, one event bus), and a scripted session over it with no Prolog engine that drives every layer (stamina, combat, traversal, locomotion, detection, routines, skills; ir.routines goes to the routine and locomotion directors). A step on a layer the world did not activate is { absent: true }. DERIVED by npm run module-activation from src/game-engine; see docs/module-contract.md §7.6. ops: every step op (core's MECHANIC_STEP_OPS, the MechanicStep union).

cases.name: survival: one meter, one graph, one bus
cases.claim: survival activates stamina, combat, traversal and routine: the swing (4), the walk (2) and the climb (15) draw on the one meter (24 → 3), so the second swing is refused as exhausted by what the climb spent; the NPC walks a leg through the same planner on its own meter (3 → 1) and its climb is refused for stamina; no perception, so the detection steps are absent; the NPC adopts its herding goal from the IR's routines and the hero buys climbing 1, both on the one bus

cases.name: rpg: no stamina module, no meter
cases.claim: rpg activates combat, traversal, perception, skill and routine but not stamina: no pool is built, so nothing is metered, both swings land, the climb and the NPC's climb are made and nothing is refused for stamina; the wolf turns suspicious on its third tick, the NPC adopts the herding goal only the IR's routines author, and the hero buys climbing 1 (120 banked, 100 spent): detection_changed, routine_changed and skill_advanced on the same bus as combat and traversal

cases.name: fighting: combat alone
cases.claim: fighting activates combat only: every stamina, traversal and locomotion step is absent and both swings land unmetered

cases.name: simulation: routines walk the graph
cases.claim: simulation activates routine and traversal (U87(6)): the locomotion director walks the traversal planner, so the NPC's pursuit arrives at the ford and then the ridge, unmetered (no stamina module), and the routine director adopts the herding goal at the ford; no combat, perception or skill, so those steps are absent

cases.name: routine alone: routines with no graph
cases.claim: a world's selection of routine without traversal: the locomotion director is built over no graph, so a pursuit is answered as unplaced and nothing moves, while the routine director still adopts the herding goal at the ford (simulation's bundle answered this before U87(6) gave it traversal)

cases.name: a world's own selection drives the runtime
cases.claim: meta.enabledModules naming combat, stamina and traversal assembles exactly those over the genre (adventure would build no combat and no meter): one pool spent by both (the climb leaves 3, the second swing is exhausted), no routine so no locomotion

cases.name: puzzle: nothing assembled
cases.claim: puzzle activates no layer this assembly owns: every step is absent, the bus is silent, puzzle is listed as not assembled

cases.name: survival with 'none': nothing assembled
cases.claim: meta.enabledModules ['none'] is the world's selection of no mechanic module (PL.core-mechanics-contract): survival's bundle would build every layer, but no layer is built, every step is absent and the bus is silent
